title: 第360章 金仙逆伐仙帝第362章 久别重逢
content_zh:
无垠星海漆黑死寂，亿万星辰悬浮于虚空之中，悠悠星光散落，却照不亮这片对决的终极战场。
追梦与归墟妖尊隔空对立，一者是人族金仙2层巅峰，肉身霸绝凡界，道心无垢；一者是妖界万古仙帝，执掌海族血脉道统，威压诸天。境界的悬殊看似天壤之别——归墟妖尊乃是实打实的仙帝至尊，超脱十阶妖皇，位列妖界最顶层战力，碾压凡界一切规则桎梏；而追梦仅为金仙2层巅峰，属仙界七阶修为，二者横跨整整三个大境界、总共二十八层小境界的差距，放在诸天修行界，是足以碾压秒杀、毫无翻盘可能的绝对壁垒。
可此刻，归墟妖尊凝重的目光，已然彻底褪去了初见晚辈的轻视。
无人知晓，追梦能逆境界抗衡仙帝巨头，是有四大逆天底蕴凭借的，这四大逆天底蕴生生抹平了看似无解的修为鸿沟。
其一，法宝逆天，成套仙品尊器加持。追梦周身盘龙战甲流光亘古，攻防一体，自带最顶级仙器防御道韵；脚下彩虹靴踏碎虚空，身法遁速冠绝同阶；掌心青霄剑蕴含诸天仙境最强剑道本源，锋锐无比。整套仙品尊器相辅相成，相生相克，激活专属套装属性，攻防、速度、杀伐之力层层叠加，每一寸威能都远超普通仙帝攻伐。
其二，功法至高，碾压万古道统。归墟妖尊修行的是海族顶级太古妖帝诀，已是诸天最顶尖的仙级功法，可追梦的《九转神功》乃诸天最顶尖的鸿蒙级炼体功法，仙级功法后面有神级功法、圣级功法、混沌级功法、然后才是鸿蒙级功法，整整高出4个大品级，肉身已经修炼到九转神功5层，万法不侵、万力可扛；辅以《熔炉大法》《小三元功》相辅，法体双修，道韵纯粹霸道，远非海族传承功法所能媲美。
其三，法体同修，战力翻倍。寻常金仙要么专修法术、要么苦修肉身，难免有所短板，而追梦肉身修炼到九转神功5层，对神人境以下的修炼者来说，强悍无敌，神魂凝练如鸿蒙晶石，法术神通炉火纯青，肉身搏杀、远程术法、神魂攻防无一短板，肉身之力叠加金仙法力道韵，每一次出手，威能都呈几何倍数暴涨。
其四，体质天赋逆天，追梦在解封自我封印的所有记忆时，花费1000万亿系统积分，在系统商城，购买了一瓶鸿蒙灵液服用，虽然修为境界只提升到金仙2层巅峰，但却恢复了逆天体质——先天鸿蒙无极至尊道体，拥有天生越阶杀伐的能力，常态可越两大境界碾压敌手，拼命状态下可硬撼三大境界强敌。此番对上仙帝，在四大优势融会贯通下，让他得以在这片无拘无束的星空之中，直面归墟妖尊的无上帝威，而丝毫不落下风。
“小辈，区区金仙境2层巅峰，也敢恃勇抗衡仙帝道体，今日本座便让你知晓，诸天境界之差，绝非旁门左道可弥补！”
归墟妖尊冷声震喝，浩瀚仙帝妖力轰然席卷整片星海，无边漆黑妖雾翻涌升腾，裹挟着吞噬星辰、湮灭虚空的至尊道力，朝着追梦狠狠碾压而来。妖雾所过之处，星辰黯淡、虚空塌陷，无数小型天体瞬间崩解为虚无。
追梦神色凛然而淡漠，无半分惧意，抬手紧握青霄剑，金仙剑道本源全力迸发。
一剑横空斩落！
璀璨青色剑光撕裂万古黑暗，极致锋利的剑道法则贯通茫茫星海，剑光所过，坚韧无比的宇宙空间壁垒如同薄纸般轻易碎裂，一道道绵延数百万里的狰狞空间裂缝纵横交错，贯穿整片战场。远处一颗颗体量堪比数十倍地球的巨型荒芜星辰，根本来不及躲闪，被剑光径直对半切开，星核崩碎、星尘溃散，在寂静星空中爆发出绚烂又惨烈的星辰湮灭之光。
一击未落，追梦踏步凌空，九转神功全力运转，周身金红光华暴涨，肉身力量攀升至极致，骤然一拳轰向迎面而来的妖帝洪流！
轰隆——！
无上拳劲破空而出，磅礴巨力震荡整片星海。周遭稳固的宇宙空间如同碎裂的琉璃，层层崩裂坍塌，密密麻麻的空间碎纹蔓延亿万里之遥，无数隐匿在虚空夹缝中的亚空间接连破碎崩塌，化作彻底的虚无。拳风席卷之处，沿途数颗巨型星辰应声炸裂，庞大的星体轰然解体，碎石、岩浆、星核本源尽数被拳力碾为最细微的星尘，飘散于茫茫虚空。
归墟妖尊眸光骤变，心中惊悍更甚，指尖快速结印，催动仙帝神通，万千黑色妖龙自妖雾中衍生而出，张牙舞爪、裹挟帝威，轮番轰击追梦周身，欲以连绵不绝的攻势耗尽他的战力。
面对漫天绝杀攻势，追梦不闪不避，心念一动，九转神功催动极致躯体巨大化。身躯从寻常人形瞬间暴涨、延展，万丈、百万丈、亿万里！转瞬之间，一尊比肩巨型星辰的无上道躯屹立星海，筋骨如龙、体魄如山，周身道韵滔天。
他长臂舒展，直接探入苍茫无垠的星际虚空，跨越亿万星河距离，精准抓住数颗体量浩瀚、亘古长存的荒芜巨型星球，随手挪移至身前，化作最坚实的肉身壁垒。
砰砰砰——！

无数妖帝神通狠狠轰击在星辰壁垒之上，仙帝之力炸裂星辰，一颗颗巨型星球层层破碎、不断消融，却尽数挡下了归墟妖尊的致命连击。坚硬星体炸裂的轰鸣此起彼伏，震彻星海，却无法伤及追梦分毫。
归墟妖尊见状，眼底杀机更盛，掌心凝聚无尽妖力，化作一道漆黑滔天的帝焰，骤然轰杀而出，速度快到极致，封锁追梦所有躲闪方位。
追梦眸光微动，单手结印，口中轻吐法诀。
寻常修士的基础法术火球术，在他金仙二层巅峰的磅礴灵力灌注下，和他先天鸿蒙无极至尊道体的加持下，彻底蜕变升华。
一颗并不算刺眼、通体赤红的火球凭空浮现，看似平平无奇，却蕴藏着焚山煮海、湮灭星辰的无上威能。这枚金仙境催动的火球，早已超脱核弹层级千倍万倍，自带焚灭神魂、消融法宝、铭刻道伤的恐怖特效，是足以重创仙帝的术法杀招。
火球破空疾射，精准轰向归墟妖尊的站位。
归墟妖尊深知这枚火球的恐怖威能，不敢硬接，身形瞬间虚化，化作一道流光侧身闪避，险之又险躲开致命一击。
可他身后百万里之外，一颗直径堪比太阳大小的巨型荒芜星辰，恰好被火球正面命中！
轰然巨响穿透万古虚空，巨型星辰瞬间炸裂解体，漫天星体碎屑纷飞。而附着其上的赤红火焰霸道至极，自带不灭道火特性，疯狂灼烧所有星尘碎片，焚灭星体本源、消融空间碎屑，一路燃烧、一路湮灭，不将所有残骸烧至彻底虚无，火焰绝不熄灭。短短数息，偌大一颗星球便被彻底焚尽，连一丝星屑都未曾留存。
一人一帝的厮杀，在无垠星空中持续了整整三日三夜。
剑光裂星河，拳力碎星球，妖帝覆九天，道火焚太虚。
归墟妖尊穷尽仙帝神通、海族至尊秘术，翻覆星海、挪移星球，攻势连绵不绝、霸道无匹；追梦则凭借逆天道体、至尊功法、成套仙品尊器、越阶天赋，剑斩妖雾、拳破帝威、术焚虚空，步步稳守、寸步不让。
三日鏖战，归墟妖尊数次催动本命帝法，欲强行镇压追梦，却始终被稳稳格挡、尽数化解；追梦数次绝杀攻势，也都被妖尊凭借仙帝底蕴艰难抵挡，无法破敌制胜。
亿万星辰崩碎湮灭，无尽虚空层层塌陷，整片星空战场满目疮痍。
最终，两道旷世身影各自后退数万里，隔空对峙，气息皆有损耗，却无人落败、无人退缩。
漫天硝烟散尽，星海渐渐恢复寂静。
金仙二层巅峰对战万古仙帝，跨越三大境界总共二十八层小境界的绝对壁垒——此战，平手！
content_en:
The boundless sea of ​​​​stars is pitch black and dead, with billions of stars suspended in the void. Starlight is scattered, but it cannot illuminate this ultimate battlefield of the showdown.
Zhui Meng and Guixu Demon Lord are facing each other across the sky. One is the pinnacle of the 2nd level Golden Immortal of the human race, his physical body dominates the mortal world, and his Taoist heart is pure; the other is the eternal immortal emperor of the demon world, in charge of the bloodline of the Sea Clan, and dominates the heavens. The disparity in realm seems to be worlds apart - Guixu Demon Lord is the real Supreme Immortal Emperor, transcending the tenth level Demon Emperor, ranking at the top of the demon world in terms of combat power, and crushing all rules and regulations in the mortal world; while Dream Chasing is only at the peak of the 2nd level of the Golden Immortal, and belongs to the 7th level of the Immortal Realm. The gap between the two spans three major realms, and a total of 28 small realms. In the world of heavenly cultivation, it is an absolute barrier that can crush an instant kill without the possibility of a comeback.
But at this moment, the solemn gaze of Guixu Demon Lord has completely lost the contempt he felt when he first met this junior.
No one knows that Chasing Dreams can go against the realm and compete with the giant Immortal Emperor because of four heaven-defying foundations. These four heaven-defying foundations have completely smoothed the seemingly unsolvable gap in cultivation.
First, the magic weapon is heaven-defying, blessed by a complete set of immortal artifacts. Chai Meng's body is covered with a coiled dragon battle armor that is timeless, integrating both offense and defense, and possesses the most top-notch defensive charm. The rainbow boots under his feet crush the void, and his movement speed is unparalleled at the same level. The Qingxiao Sword in his palm contains the origin of the strongest swordsmanship in all the heavenly realms, and is extremely sharp. The entire set of immortal weapons complements and restrains each other, activating the exclusive set attributes. The attack, defense, speed, and killing power are superimposed layer by layer. Every inch of power far exceeds the attack of ordinary immortal emperors.
Second, the skill is supreme and can crush the eternal orthodoxy. The Guixu Demon Lord practices the Sea Clan’s top Ancient Demon Emperor Art, which is already the top Immortal-level technique in the world. The Dream-Chasing "Nine Revolutions Divine Art" is the top Hongmeng-level body-training technique in the world. After the Immortal-level techniques, there are God-level techniques, Saint-level techniques, Chaos-level techniques, and then It is a Hongmeng level skill, a full 4 levels higher. The physical body has been cultivated to the fifth level of the nine-turn magic skill. It is invulnerable to all methods and can bear all kinds of power. It is supplemented by the "Melting Furnace Technique" and "Little Three Yuan Gong". It cultivates both the legal body and the Tao Yun. It is pure and domineering, far beyond the skills inherited by the Sea Clan.
Thirdly, fellow cultivators of the Dharma Body will have their combat power doubled. Ordinary Golden Immortals either specialize in spells or cultivate their physical bodies, and inevitably have shortcomings. However, Dream Chaser's physical body has been cultivated to the fifth level of the Nine Transformation Divine Skills. It is invincible to cultivators below the divine-human realm. His soul is condensed like a Hongmeng crystal.
Fourth, his physical talent is heaven-defying. When Zhui Meng unblocked all his self-sealed memories, he spent 1,000 trillion system points to buy a bottle of Hongmeng Spiritual Liquid in the system mall. Although his cultivation realm was only raised to the peak of the 2nd level of Golden Immortal, he recovered his heaven-defying physique - the innate Hongmeng Wuji Supreme Dao Body. It has the innate ability to cross levels and kill. Normally, it can cross two realms to crush the opponent, and under desperate conditions, it can defeat powerful enemies in three realms. This time against the Immortal Emperor, with the integration of the four major advantages, he was able to face the unfettered power of the Guixu Demon Lord in this unfettered starry sky without losing the slightest advantage.
"Junior, you are only at the peak of the second level of the Golden Immortal Realm, but you dare to bravely compete with the Immortal Emperor Dao Body. Today, I will let you know that the difference between the realms of the heavens cannot be made up by heresy!"
The Guixu Demon Lord shouted coldly, and the vast Immortal Emperor's demonic power suddenly swept across the entire sea of ​​stars. The boundless black demonic mist surged and rose, carrying the supreme Tao power that swallowed the stars and annihilated the void, crushing towards Dream Chaser. Wherever the demonic mist passed, the stars dimmed, the void collapsed, and countless small celestial bodies instantly disintegrated into nothingness.
Zhui Meng's expression was stern but indifferent, without any fear. He raised his hand and grasped the Qingxiao Sword tightly, unleashing the full strength of the Golden Immortal Sword Technique.
A sword slashed across the air!
The bright blue sword light tears through the eternal darkness, and the extremely sharp sword law penetrates the vast sea of ​​​​stars.However, the extremely tough space barrier shattered as easily as tissue paper, and ferocious space cracks stretching for millions of miles crisscrossed the entire battlefield. The giant barren stars in the distance, which were dozens of times the size of the Earth, had no time to dodge. They were cut in half by the sword light. The star cores shattered and the star dust dispersed. A gorgeous and tragic light of star annihilation erupted in the silent starry sky.
Before the blow fell, Zhui Meng stepped into the air, the Nine Turns Divine Art was operating at full strength, the golden red light all over his body surged, his physical strength reached the extreme, and he suddenly punched the oncoming demon emperor's torrent!
Boom——!
The supreme fist force shot out of the air, and the majestic force shook the entire star sea. The stable cosmic space around him was like broken glass, with layers of it crumbling and collapsing. The dense space cracks spread hundreds of millions of miles away. Countless subspaces hidden in the cracks of the void shattered and collapsed one after another, turning into complete nothingness. Wherever the fist wind swept through, several giant stars exploded along the way, and the huge star suddenly disintegrated. The rubble, magma, and star cores were all crushed into the tiniest stardust by the force of the fist, and scattered in the vast void.
The eyes of the Guixu Demon Lord changed suddenly, and his heart became even more frightened. He quickly formed seals with his fingertips, activating the Immortal Emperor's magical power. Thousands of black demonic dragons emerged from the demonic mist. They bared their teeth and claws, wrapped up the emperor's power, and bombarded Dream Chaser in turn, hoping to exhaust his combat power with a continuous offensive.
Faced with the overwhelming offensive, Chai Meng did not dodge or dodge. With a thought, the nine-turn magic skill activated the ultimate body enlargement. The body suddenly expanded and expanded from an ordinary human form to tens of thousands of feet, millions of feet, and billions of miles away! In the blink of an eye, a supreme Taoist body as big as a giant star stood in the sea of ​​​​stars, with muscles and bones like a dragon, a body like a mountain, and a Taoist charm all over the body.
He stretched out his long arms and directly penetrated into the boundless interstellar void, spanning the distance of billions of galaxies, accurately grasping several vast and eternal desolate giant planets, and moved them in front of him, turning them into the most solid physical barriers.
Bang bang bang——!
Countless Demon Emperor's magical powers fiercely bombarded the star barrier, and the power of the Immortal Emperor exploded the stars. The giant planets were broken and melted layer by layer, but they all blocked the fatal combos of Guixu Demon Lord. The roars of the hard stars exploding came and went, shaking the sea of ​​​​stars, but they were unable to harm Chai Meng in the slightest.
Seeing this, Demon Lord Guixu's eyes became more murderous. He gathered endless demonic power in his palms and transformed into a jet-black imperial flame. He suddenly blasted out with extremely fast speed, blocking all dodge directions of Dream Chasing.
Zhui Meng's eyes moved slightly, he formed a seal with one hand, and softly uttered the magic formula in his mouth.
The basic spell of ordinary monks, the fireball technique, was completely transformed and sublimated under the infusion of the majestic spiritual power of his second-level Golden Immortal peak and the blessing of his innate Hongmeng Wuji Supreme Taoist body.
A not too dazzling, red fireball appeared out of thin air. It seemed ordinary, but it contained the supreme power of burning mountains, boiling seas, and annihilating stars. This fireball activated by the Golden Fairyland has already surpassed the level of nuclear bombs by thousands of times. It has the terrifying special effects of incinerating souls, melting magic weapons, and inscribing pathological wounds. It is a killing move that can severely damage the Immortal Emperor.
The fireball shot through the air and hit the Guixu Demon Lord's position accurately.
Demon Lord Guixu was well aware of the terrifying power of this fireball and did not dare to take it head-on. His body instantly became insubstantial and turned into a stream of light. He dodged sideways, narrowly escaping the fatal blow.
But a million miles away behind him, a giant barren star with a diameter as big as the sun happened to be hit head-on by a fireball!
A loud bang penetrated the eternal void, the giant stars exploded and disintegrated instantly, and star debris flew all over the sky. The red flame attached to it is extremely domineering and possesses the characteristics of immortal fire. It crazily burns all stardust fragments, incinerates the source of stars, and dissolves space debris. It burns and annihilates all the way. The flame will never be extinguished until all the remains are burned to complete nothingness. In just a few breaths, such a large planet was completely burned, not even a trace of stardust remained.
The fight between one person and one emperor continues in the endless starry skyFor three whole days and three nights.
The light of the sword split the galaxy, the power of the fist shattered the planet, the demon emperor covered the nine heavens, and the Tao fire burned Taixu.
The Demon Lord Gui Xu exhausted all the magical powers of the Immortal Emperor and the Supreme Secret Techniques of the Sea Clan, overturning the sea of ​​stars and moving the planets, with a continuous and unparalleled offensive; Chai Meng relied on the heaven-defying Taoist body, the Supreme Kung Fu, a complete set of Immortal Weapons, and transcendent talents to cut through the demon mist with his sword, break the emperor's power with his fists, and burn the void with his skills, holding on steadily without giving in an inch.
After three days of fierce fighting, Guixu Demon Lord activated his native emperor's magic several times in an attempt to forcibly suppress Dream Chaser, but was always firmly blocked and resolved. Zhuimeng's several killing attacks were all resisted by Demon Master with the help of the Immortal Emperor's foundation, and he was unable to defeat the enemy.
Billions of stars collapsed and were destroyed, the endless void collapsed layer by layer, and the entire starry sky battlefield was devastated.
In the end, the two unparalleled figures each retreated tens of thousands of miles and faced each other in the air. Both of their breaths were depleted, but no one was defeated or flinched.
The smoke in the sky cleared, and the sea of ​​​​stars gradually returned to silence.
The second-level Golden Immortal peak fights against the Eternal Immortal Emperor, an absolute barrier that spans three major realms and a total of twenty-eight smaller realms—this battle is a draw!
